467:   unsigned int count;
468: 
469:   if (node->channel != 0 || node->num == 0 ||
470:       node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
471:     {
472:       return;
473:     }
474: 
475:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
476:     {
477:       uint32_t next;
478:       unsigned int previous;
479: 
480:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
481:           !wifi_validate_command(address, &next))
482:         {
483:           return;
484:         }
485:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
486:         {
487:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
488:             {
489:               return;
490:             }
491:         }
492:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
493:         {
494:           return;
495:         }

497:       addresses[count] = address;
498:       address = next;
499:     }

501:   if (address != 0)
502:     {
503:       return;
504:     }
505: 
506:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
507:     {
508:       if (generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
509:         {
510:           return;
511:         }
512: 
513:       wifi_handle_command(addresses[count], generation);
514:     }

683: static void wifi_handle_data(const struct wifi_pending_node *pending)
684: {
685:   const struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node *node = &pending->node;
686:   uint32_t addresses[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
687:   bool cp_owned[BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST];
688:   struct wifi_recycle_entry *recycle;
689:   uint32_t address = node->head;
690:   uint8_t packet_added = 0;
691:   unsigned int count;
692:   irqstate_t flags;
693: 
694:   if (!pending->recycle_reserved || node->channel != 2 ||
695:       node->num == 0 || node->num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
696:     {
697:       return;
698:     }
699: 
700:   recycle = &g_wifi.recycle[pending->recycle_index];
701:   if (pending->generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
702:     {
703:       flags = up_irq_save();
704:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
705:       up_irq_restore(flags);
706:       return;
707:     }
708: 
709:   /* First pass validates the complete list without changing either core's
710:    * ownership.  A malformed list is left untouched.
711:    */
712: 
713:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
714:     {
715:       struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu cpdu;
716:       struct wifi_tx_slot *tx;
717:       uint32_t next;
718:       unsigned int previous;
719: 
720:       if (address == 0)
721:         {
722:           goto invalid;
723:         }
724: 
725:       for (previous = 0; previous < count; previous++)
726:         {
727:           if (addresses[previous] == address)
728:             {
729:               goto invalid;
730:             }
731:         }
732: 
733:       if ((count + 1 == node->num) != (address == node->tail))
734:         {
735:           goto invalid;
736:         }
737: 
738:       addresses[count] = address;
739:       tx = wifi_tx_slot(address);
740:       if (tx != NULL)
741:         {
742:           struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *ap_cpdu =
743:             (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
744: 
745:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0)
746:             {
747:               goto invalid;
748:             }
749: 
750:           cp_owned[count] = false;
751:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
752:         }
753:       else
754:         {
755:           if (!wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
756:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL))
757:             {
758:               goto invalid;
759:             }
760: 
761:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
762:           cp_owned[count] = true;
763:           next = cpdu.next;
764:         }
765: 
766:       address = next;
767:     }
768: 
769:   if (address != 0)
770:     {
771:       goto invalid;
772:     }
773: 
774:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
775:     {
776:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
777:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
778:         {
779:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
780:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
781: 
782:           if (wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index]))
783:             {
784:               packet_added++;
785:             }
786:         }
787:     }
788: 
789:   flags = up_irq_save();
790:   if (pending->generation !=
791:       bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
792:     {
793:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
794:       up_irq_restore(flags);
795:       return;
796:     }
797: 
798:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
799:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
800:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
801:     {
802:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
803:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
804:         {
805:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
806:         }
807:     }
808: 
809:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
810:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
811:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
812:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
813:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
814:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
815:   up_irq_restore(flags);
816: 
817:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
818:     {
819:       if (!cp_owned[count])
820:         {
821:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
822: 
823:           netpkt_free(&g_wifi.lower, tx->packet, NETPKT_TX);
824:           tx->packet = NULL;
825:           tx->active = false;
826:           netdev_lower_txdone(&g_wifi.lower);
827:         }
828:     }
829:   if (packet_added != 0)
830:     {
831:       netdev_lower_rxready(&g_wifi.lower);
832:     }
833:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
834:   return;
835: 
836: invalid:
837:   flags = up_irq_save();
838:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
839:   up_irq_restore(flags);
840: }

655: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
656: {
657:   struct ack_slot *slot;
658:   unsigned int rx_index;
659:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
660:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
661:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
662:   uint8_t state = 0;
663:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
664: 
665:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
666:     {
667:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
668:       if (slot == NULL)
669:         {
670:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
671:           return -EAGAIN;
672:         }
673:     }
674:   else
675:     {
676:       slot = NULL;
677:     }
678: 
679:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
680:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
681:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
682:     {
683:       g_stats.bad_header++;
684:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
685:     }
686:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
687:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
688:     {
689:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
690:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
691:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
692:         {
693:           if (slot != NULL)
694:             {
695:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
696:             }
697: 
698:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
699:           return -EAGAIN;
700:         }
701:       else if (ret < 0)
702:         {
703:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
704:         }
705:     }
706:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)

708:       g_pwc_rx(message);
709:       ret = OK;
710:     }
711:   else
712:     {
713:       g_stats.unsupported++;
714:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
715:     }

193: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
194: {
195:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
199:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
200:    */
201: 
202:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
203:     {
204:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
205:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
206:       g_processing_order = 0;
207:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
208:         {
209:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
210:           break;
211:         }
212: 
213:       desc->used = false;
214:     }
215: 
216:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
217:     {
218:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
219:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
220:       g_processing_order = 0;
221:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
222:         {
223:           break;
224:         }
225: 
226:       desc->used = false;
227:     }
228: }

230: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
231: {
232:   (void)irq;
233:   (void)context;
234:   (void)arg;
235: 
236:   mbox_clear_errors();
237: 
238:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
239:     {
240:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
241:       uint32_t address;
242:       uint32_t length;
243:       uint8_t source;
244: 
245:       mbox_process_desc();
246:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
247:       if (desc == NULL)
248:         {
249:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
250:           break;
251:         }
252: 
253:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
254:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
255:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
256:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))

264:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
265:       desc->used = true;
266:       g_stats.rx_messages++;

+# BK7258 OpenVela AP Wi-Fi 移植实施与验证方案
+

Edit current BK7258 Wi-Fi implementation to fix final review findings. Use apply_patch. Work in both contest BK7258 board tree and bk_avdk_smp CP only as needed. Do not package, but build/syntax check.

Required fixes:
1. AP deadlock: never call netdev_lower_carrier_on/off, netdev_lower_rxready, netdev_lower_txdone, or netpkt_free while packet_lock is held. Refactor worker/data handling to collect notifications/completions and invoke after unlocking. Ensure lock order cannot be packet_lock -> NuttX network lock while transmit is network lock -> packet_lock. wifi_set_carrier from command event must happen outside packet_lock.
2. Generation coalescing: do not depend solely on link callback seeing non-READY. In worker and/or READY callback compare bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation against g_wifi.reset_generation and run generation synchronization before processing nodes. Refactor reset synchronization into helper. Never dereference stale pointers. Do not block forever on a future-generation node.
3. CP cif_dnld_buffer: propagate cif_msg_sender failures. Because source mailbox callback uses uint8_t but BK errors may be negative, inspect typedef. Return nonzero failure so mailbox sends COM_FAIL and AP transport callback sees failure. More importantly AP command and data sends need transport completion callbacks that reclaim command/TX ownership when COM_FAIL proves CP did not accept node. For successful ACK ownership remains CP. Add callbacks and safe per-slot state as necessary. Do not reclaim on timeout/reset where acceptance is uncertain. For data recycle path existing callback already retries.
4. AP command send currently uses callback NULL. Add transport callback tied to command slot so COM_FAIL can set pattern free/owned false and wake pending command with error. Avoid stack callback arg. AP TX send callback on definite EREMOTEIO should clear active and free packet/txdone outside packet_lock; on timeout/reset quarantine. Respect upper-half packet ownership.
5. CP scan start: call bk_wifi_scan_start first, confirm int32 status, return actual status. AP scan start must request and validate 4-byte status before setting scan_running. If start fails, return error and do not stay busy.
6. For proven peer reset, orphan accepted command slots can be safely reset only if CP reset means old CP cannot access AP pointers. Clear command pattern/owned and wake requests. TX slots remain quarantined because DMA safety is uncertain per current documented choice. CP event slots are CP-owned and can be reset in CP reset handling only if a suitable hook exists; otherwise document residual.
7. Build AP exact command with -Werror. Syntax-check CP files or incremental compile. Return exact changes and residual reset orphan limitations.

## Objective
- 阅读并修正过时的 `BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_PORTING_PLAN.md`，完成 BK7258 OpenVela Wi-Fi STA 移植。
- 构建包含 OpenVela AP、Armino CP 和 bootloader 的最终固件 `all-app.bin`。

## Important Details
- OpenVela 正式源码位于 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/`。
- 原计划“完全不修改 CP”不可行：当前 CP 会消费 DHCP/DNS/ARP，且普通 STA connected event 未上报 AP。
- 最终架构保留 CP 的 RWNX、WPA、MAC/PHY/RF，新增最小 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4` 兼容扩展；NuttX 拥有基础设施 STA 的 IPv4/ARP。
- Mailbox 通道固定为 AP→CP `0x14/0x15`、CP→AP `0x44/0x45`。
- 数据面兼容 direct-push ABI：16-byte pbuf、8-byte CPDU、708-byte RWNX TX headroom、最多 60 个 RX list 节点。
- Scan/country 使用固定宽度扩展命令 `0x20d`、`0x20e`、`0x20f`，不跨核传递私有 pointer。
- AP 使用 NuttX `netdev_lowerhalf` 和 `NET_LL_IEEE80211`，设备名为 `wlan0`。
- CP `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY` 保持关闭；EAPOL、SoftAP、P2P 仍归 CP。
- 不记录 Wi-Fi 密码，不硬编码凭据。
- 构建命令：
  `./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh -e -Werror --cmake -j8`
- 最终打包命令：

- 审计了旧 Wi-Fi 计划、当前 BK7258 Mailbox、CP `controller_if`、NuttX lower-half API 和 `app_ab` 构建链。

- 启用 NuttX IPv4、ARP、ICMP、TCP、UDP、DHCP client、WAPI 和 1514-byte frame。
- CP 新增 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4=y`，基础设施 STA 的 ARP/IPv4 转发给 OpenVela，关闭 CP STA DHCP/ARP reply。
- CP 补发 STA connected/disconnected event，抑制重复 no-AP disconnect。
- CP RX/TX pbuf recycle 改为匹配原厂双引用释放语义。
- 删除 CP connect handler 中的明文密码日志。

### Active

1: # BK7258 最终固件构建步骤
2: 
3: 本文记录当前工作区已经验证通过的构建流程。最终固件由以下三部分组成：
4: 
5: ```text
6: OpenVela CPU1/AP nuttx.bin
7: Armino CPU0/CP app.bin
8: Beken bootloader.bin
9:         |
10:         v
11: Beken packager
12:         |
13:         v
14: all-app.bin
15: ```
16: 
17: OpenVela 只构建 AP raw binary。CP、bootloader、分区生成和最终打包均由
18: `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab` 完成。不要手工覆盖打包目录中的 `app1.bin`，
19: 应使用已经接入的 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口。
20: 
21: ## 1. 前置条件
22: 
23: 工作区路径：
24: 
25: ```text
26: /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
27: /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
28: ```
29: 
30: 确认官方 Armino 1.5 Podman 镜像存在：
31: 
32: ```bash
33: podman images
34: ```
35: 
36: 应包含：
37: 
38: ```text
39: localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5
40: ```
41: 
42: `app_ab` 使用自己的分区配置：
43: 
44: ```text
45: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv
46: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
47: ```
48: 
49: 不得混用 `bk_solution_ai` 等其他项目的分区文件。
50: 
51: ## 2. 构建 OpenVela AP
52: 
53: ```bash
54: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
55: 
56: ./build.sh \
57:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
58:   -e -Werror \
59:   --cmake \
60:   -j8
61: ```
62: 
63: 如修改过 `Kconfig` 或 `defconfig`，建议先删除旧 CMake 配置：
64:

67:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
68:   --cmake distclean
69: ```
70: 
71: 实际输出：

75: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin   # AP raw binary

77: ```

79: 检查 AP 文件：

83: sha256sum cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin

86: AP 必须使用 Cortex-M33 hard-float 配置，链接地址必须与 `app_ab` 的 AP
87: 布局匹配，并且 `nuttx.bin` 不得超过 AP 分区容量。
88: 
89: ## 3. 准备外部 AP 输入
90: 
91: Podman 只挂载 `bk_avdk_smp`，因此先把 AP raw binary 复制到 SDK 内部：

103:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
104:   /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin

107: ## 4. 构建 CP 并打包最终固件

109: 在 `bk_avdk_smp` 根目录执行：

111: ```bash
112: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp

124: 该命令自动完成：

126: 1. 生成 `app_ab` 分区文件。

128: 3. 获取 Beken bootloader。
129: 4. 将 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 复制为打包输入 `app1.bin`。
130: 5. 调用标准 Beken packager 生成最终固件。

134: ## 5. 输出文件

154: ```
155: 
156: 实际完整路径的共同前缀为：

158: ```text

160: ```
161: 
162: ## 6. 构建后校验
163: 
164: 首先确认最终文件存在：
165: 
166: ```bash
167: ls -lh \
168:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin \
169:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
170: ```
171: 
172: 然后确认 packager 使用了本次构建的 OpenVela AP：
173: 
174: ```bash
175: sha256sum \
176:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
177:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
178:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
179: 
180: cmp -s \
181:   /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
182:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
183: ```
184: 
185: 三个 SHA256 必须一致，`cmp` 必须返回 0。否则生成的 `all-app.bin` 可能仍包含旧 AP。
186: 
187: 检查分区和构建摘要：
188: 
189: ```bash
190: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/bk_package.json
191: cat projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
192: ```
193: 
194: `bk_package.json` 应包含：
195: 
196: ```text
197: bootloader.bin -> bootloader
198: app.bin        -> CPU0/CP app
199: app1.bin       -> CPU1/AP app
200: ```
201: 
202: 注意：`build_summary.txt` 中的 AP memory info 来自构建过程中的 Armino AP
203: 占位镜像 map，不用于证明外部 OpenVela AP 已经打包。外部 AP 是否生效必须以
204: `nuttx.bin`、`build/openvela-ap.bin` 和 `package/tmp/app1.bin` 的哈希及
205: 逐字节比较为准。
206: 
207: ## 7. 常见问题
208: 
209: - OpenVela CMake 构建产物是 `nuttx.bin` 和 `System.map`，不是
210:   `vela_nuttx.bin` 或 `nuttx.map`。
211: - 当前 OpenVela 工作树是 `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest`，不是旧的
212:   `openvela_bk7258_dev`。
213: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 必须填写容器内路径
214:   `/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin`，不能填写宿主机绝对路径。
215: - 修改配置后若增量构建没有加载新配置，先执行 CMake `distclean`。
216: - 最终烧录文件名是 `all-app.bin`，不是 `all_app.bin`。

5. 首次烧录必须使用 `all-app.bin`，不要使用 `app_ab_crc.rbl`；后者是 OTA 包。

串口控制台配置：

```text
UART0 RX: GPIO10
UART0 TX: GPIO11
波特率: 115200
数据格式: 8-N-1
流控: 无
```

**进入 AP NSH**
上电后默认看到 CP CLI。执行：

```text
ap_console status
ap_console open
```

成功后进入 OpenVela AP 的 NSH 控制台。先检查接口：

```text
ifconfig
ifup wlan0
ifconfig wlan0
```

应能看到 `wlan0` 及有效 MAC 地址。

**扫描测试**
```text
wapi country wlan0 CN
wapi scan wlan0
```

预期输出附近 AP 的 BSSID、频率、RSSI、加密方式和 SSID。扫描最多等待约 5 秒。

**连接 WPA2 热点**
建议先使用临时的 2.4 GHz WPA2-PSK/CCMP 手机热点。依次执行：

```text
wapi mode wlan0 WAPI_MODE_MANAGED
wapi psk wlan0 "你的密码" WPA_ALG_CCMP WPA_VER_2
wapi essid wlan0 "你的SSID" WAPI_ESSID_ON
```

`wapi essid` 会触发实际连接。等待关联完成后获取地址：

```text
renew wlan0
ifconfig wlan0
route
```

验收标准：

- `renew wlan0` 不报告超时。
- `ifconfig wlan0` 显示热点分配的 IPv4 地址和子网掩码。
- `route` 显示默认网关。
- 串口没有 assert、hard fault、Mailbox timeout 或反复 reset。

测试时尽量使用临时热点密码，避免把正式密码保存在串口日志中。

**连通性测试**
用 `route` 查到网关地址后执行：

```text
ping -c 5 <网关IP>
ping -c 20 -s 1400 <网关IP>
ping -c 5 1.1.1.1
```

第二条用于覆盖接近 MTU 的 TX/RX 数据路径。当前固件没有 DNS 客户端，因此应使用 IP 地址，不要用域名。

从同一局域网内的电脑反向测试开发板：

```bash
ping -c 20 <wlan0的IP地址>
```

通过标准：

- 网关双向 ping 正常。
- 1400-byte ping 不出现数据损坏。
- 电脑能够 ping 通开发板。
- 连续测试期间系统不死锁、不重启。

**断线重连**
```text
wapi disconnect wlan0
wapi essid wlan0 "你的SSID" WAPI_ESSID_ON
renew wlan0
ping -c 5 <网关IP>
```

建议连续执行 10 轮，并测试关闭热点 30 秒后重新开启。每轮都应重新关联、获取地址并恢复 ping。

当前结果说明：

- `wlan0` 注册和 `ifup` 正常。
- MAC 地址读取正常。
- 显示的 IPv4 地址是编译时默认静态地址，不代表 DHCP 已成功。
- `wapi country wlan0 CN` 成功时不输出内容，这是正常行为。
- `wapi scan wlan0` 没有结果表头，属于异常。

根因是 CP 只在 `scan_id != 0` 时发送扫描完成通知，而 OpenVela 通过直接 Wi-Fi API 发起的扫描 ID 为 `0`。扫描实际执行后，AP 收不到完成事件，一直认为扫描仍在进行。

1330:  * Name: wapi_scan_coll
1331:  *
1332:  * Description:
1333:  *   Collects the results of a scan process.
1334:  *
1335:  * Input Parameters:
1336:  *   aps - Pushes collected  struct wapi_scan_info_s into this list.
1337:  *
1338:  ****************************************************************************/
1339: 
1340: int wapi_scan_coll(int sock, FAR const char *ifname,
1341:                    FAR struct wapi_list_s *aps)
1342: {
1343:   FAR char *buf;
1344:   int buflen;
1345:   struct iwreq wrq =
1346:   {
1347:   };
1348: 
1349:   int ret;
1350: 
1351:   WAPI_VALIDATE_PTR(aps);
1352: 
1353:   buflen = CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI_SCAN_MAX_DATA;
1354:   buf = malloc(buflen);
1355:   if (!buf)
1356:     {
1357:       WAPI_STRERROR("malloc()");
1358:       return -ENOMEM;
1359:     }
1360: 
1361: retry:
1362:   memset(buf, 0, buflen);
1363: 
1364:   /* Collect results. */
1365: 
1366:   wrq.u.data.pointer = buf;
1367:   wrq.u.data.length  = buflen;
1368:   wrq.u.data.flags   = 0;
1369:   strlcpy(wrq.ifr_name, ifname, IFNAMSIZ);
1370: 
1371:   ret = ioctl(sock, SIOCGIWSCAN, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&wrq));
1372:   if (ret < 0 && errno == E2BIG)
1373:     {
1374:       FAR char *tmp;
1375: 
1376:       buflen *= 2;
1377:       tmp = malloc(buflen);
1378:       free(buf);
1379:       if (!tmp)
1380:         {
1381:           WAPI_STRERROR("malloc()");
1382:           return -ENOMEM;
1383:         }
1384: 
1385:       buf = tmp;
1386:       goto retry;
1387:     }
1388: 
1389:   /* There is still something wrong. It's either EAGAIN or some other ioctl()
1390:    * failure. We don't bother, let the user deal with it.
1391:    */
1392: 
1393:   if (ret < 0)
1394:     {
1395:       int errcode = errno;
1396:       WAPI_IOCTL_STRERROR(SIOCGIWSCAN, errcode);
1397:       free(buf);
1398:       return -errcode;
1399:     }
1400: 
1401:   /* We have the results, process them. */
1402: 
1403:   if (wrq.u.data.length)
1404:     {
1405:       struct iw_event iwe;
1406:       struct wapi_event_stream_s stream;
1407: 
1408:       wapi_event_stream_init(&stream, buf, wrq.u.data.length);
1409:       do
1410:         {
1411:           /* Get the next event from the stream */
1412: 
1413:           ret = wapi_event_stream_extract(&stream, &iwe);
1414:           if (ret > 0)
1415:             {
1416:               int eventret = wapi_scan_event(&iwe, aps);
1417:               if (eventret < 0)
1418:                 {
1419:                   ret = eventret;
1420:                 }
1421:             }
1422:           else if (ret < 0)
1423:             {
1424:               WAPI_ERROR("ERROR: wapi_event_stream_extract() failed!\n");
1425:             }
1426:         }
1427:       while (ret > 0);
1428:     }
1429: 
1430:   /* Free request buffer. */
1431: 
1432:   free(buf);
1433:   return ret;
1434: }

213:                                        * (scan results); This includes id and

231:                                        * Response. The data includes id and
232:                                        * length fields and may contain more
233:                                        * than one IE. This may be sent
234:                                        * between IWEVASSOCREQIE and
235:                                        * IWEVREGISTERED events for the
236:                                        * association. */

238:                                        * pre-authentication

244: /* Other Common Wireless Definitions ****************************************/
245: 
246: /* Maximum size of the ESSID and NICKN strings */
247: 
248: #define IW_ESSID_MAX_SIZE   32

250: /* Modes of operation */

`wapi scan` 返回 `1` 的第二个根因已定位：CP 分页实现每获取一页都会调用 `bk_wifi_scan_get_result()`，而这个 API 会清空底层扫描结果。环境中 AP 超过 4 个时：

1. 第一页成功读取 4 个 AP。
2. 第一页读取后底层结果被清空。
3. 第二页返回空结果或协议错误。
4. `wapi scan` 以状态 `1` 结束，没有打印结果表。

已改为：

- 首次分页请求保存完整扫描结果快照。
- 后续页面从同一快照读取。
- 最后一页发送完成后释放快照。
- 新扫描前清理上一次未完成的快照。
- 保留 `scan_id == 0` 完成通知修复。
- AP 直接打印扫描启动、传输和分页协议错误。

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
14: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
15: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
16: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |
17: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | MB_UART0 唯一 owner、LOG/RAW RX、1024 B TX ring 和 worker |
18: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | 完整 ACK 匹配、timeout/reset、probe 和诊断 |
19: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | IPC power-up ready 门禁事件 |
20: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | heartbeat/reset/down 自动回退事件 |
21: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | 严格 DATA/STATE 校验、ACK 后推进和 link event |
22: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | command/ACK/reset/sync 分离稳定 slot |
23: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | 稳定 slot 完成和 quarantine 接口 |
24: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | RX 资源门禁、FIFO poll 和 destination count |
25: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | MBOX0 poll、ready callback 和 FIFO count API |
26: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | PWC boot-ready 门禁事件 |
27: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
28: 
29: UART0 bridge 保持 `MB_UART0` 唯一初始化 owner。AP 输出 LOG 模式保留 `ap0:`
30: 前缀、50 ms 半行刷新和有限重试；RAW 模式不改写字节。PC 到 AP 输入使用
31: 1024 B 有界 ring 和部分写 worker，所有物理 UART0 输出仍经 shell queue 串行化。
32: 
33: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
34: 七区域布局：
35: 
36: ```text
37: 0x60000000..0x60700000  四个媒体 slab，共 7 MiB
38: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
39: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
40: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
41: ```

100: ## 3. 正确构建链条
101: 
102: 最终固件链条固定为：
103: 
104: ```text
105: OpenVela nuttx.bin
106:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
107:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
108:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
109:   -> package/all-app.bin
110: 
111: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
112:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
113: ```
114: 
115: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
116: 
117: - `ram_regions.csv`
118: - AP/CP `config`
119: - Kconfig 默认值
120: - 分区生成脚本
121: - SoC 链接脚本
122: 
123: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
124: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
125: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
126: 
127: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
128: 
129: ```bash
130: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
131: ./build.sh \
132:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
133:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
134: 
135: cp \
136:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
137:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
138: ```
139: 
140: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
141: 
142: ```bash
143: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
144: make -C projects/app_ab clean
145: 
146: podman run --rm \
147:   --userns=keep-id \
148:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
149:   -w /armino \
150:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
151:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
152:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
153:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
154: ```
155: 
156: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
157: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
158: 
159: ## 4. 构建验收
160: 
161: 以下文件必须都反映同一份 16 MiB 布局：
162: 
163: ```text
164: projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
165: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h
166: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
167: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
168: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/bk7258/bk7258_out.ld
169: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_out.ld
170: ```
171: 
172: 关键值应为：
173: 
174: ```text
175: CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY          0x01000000
176: CP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60700000 + 0x00020000
177: AP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60720000 + 0x002e0000
178: AP_PSRAM_SECTION              0x60a00000 + 0x00600000
179: PSRAM 最终边界                0x61000000
180: ```
181: 
182: 外部 AP 输入和最终打包输入必须完全一致：
183: 
184: ```bash
185: sha256sum \
186:   ~/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
187:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
188:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
189: 
190: cmp -s \
191:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
192:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
193: ```
194: 
195: 检查最终产物：
196: 
197: ```text
198: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
199: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
200: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
201: ```
202: 
203: `build_summary.txt`中的 AP 内存统计来自 Armino AP 占位镜像，只用于检查生成的
204: 内存区域边界；它不代表最终打包的 OpenVela AP 静态占用。OpenVela AP 的静态
205: 内存应以 `nuttx.map`或`System.map`为准。
206: 
207: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
208: 
209: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
210: 
211: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
212: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
213: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
214: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
215: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
216: - 当前SMP协议兼容的`0x7/0x8/0x9/0xa`PWC处理和PSRAM_REQUIRED ready门禁。
217: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
218: 
219: 当前CP协议不通过`0xc`或其他命令暴露PSRAM initialized、device ID和actual capacity。
220: `0x7`响应只回显ON/OFF状态，不能单独证明PHY初始化成功或器件为16 MiB。因此当前

153: ## 3. 正确构建链条
154: 
155: 最终固件链条固定为：
156: 
157: ```text
158: OpenVela nuttx.bin
159:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
160:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
161:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
162:   -> package/all-app.bin
163: 
164: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
165:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
166: ```
167: 
168: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
169: 
170: - `ram_regions.csv`
171: - AP/CP `config`
172: - Kconfig 默认值
173: - 分区生成脚本
174: - SoC 链接脚本
175: 
176: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
177: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
178: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
179: 
180: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：

+OpenVela使用独立owner，初始化失败不置owner bit。`0xc`已提供frequency/divider、
+speed、voltage、CPU power/reset和PSRAM owner只读诊断；device ID和actual capacity
+仍未暴露，因此alias probe和整颗器件实板测试仍是容量门禁。AP board必须同步发送
+V1 version并检查真实ret/version后才能联调；本CP侧任务未修改AP board代码。
+
+PWC ready 使用两阶段契约：AP 的既有 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5` 仅解除 CP boot
+worker 等待，不发布最终 PWC/bridge ready。新增 `PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 由 mailbox
+ISR 排入 low-power worker；`param1=1` 表示 AP 已完成 PSRAM/SMP commit，CP 只有在
+boot stage 5、CPU1/CPU2 power、CPU2 hold、480 MHz clock 和 OpenVela PSRAM owner
+全部通过 readback 后才进入 stage 6 并发布 PWC ready。`param1=0` 时 `param2` 必须是
+真实负 errno，CP 执行 best-effort 完整 rollback。正常 recovery 的 INIT/拒绝会取消
+shutdown 并恢复 boot vote；只有 FINISH 才进入 shutdown。CP 不实现 runtime DVFS/P1，
+也不在 recovery INIT 路径直接停止 CPU2。
